==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* His nickname is a play on his old soloqueue id, '''dyN''', and the name of a famous Brazilian funk MC, '''MC Brinquedo'''.<ref>[https://sportv.globo.com/site/e-sportv/noticia/dynquedo-o-jovem-que-se-inspirou-no-funk-e-virou-o-melhor-jogador-do-cblol-em-2018 Dynquedo: o jovem que se inspirou no funk e virou o melhor jogador do CBLoL em 2018 (Portuguese)] ''sportv.globo.com''</ref>
* After winning [[2023_Season_Kickoff/Brazil|Season Kickoff Brazil 2023]] he decided on creating a {{ci|sylas}} emote holding a soundbox with a [[paiN Gaming]] logo on it. It is actually inspired in a old [https://imgur.com/L71pkG9 picture] of '''dyNquedo''' with a soundbox while he was in [[Prodigy Esports]].<ref>[https://twitter.com/SkinSpotlights/status/1634258440229888026 Skin Spotlights' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* Is a big friend of [[Brucer]], who he jokingly says is his "boyfriend".<ref>[https://x.com/CBOLAOgg/status/1731356415451648016 CBOLÃO's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* Was featured in '''LoL Esports Plays of the Week''' with his {{ci|yone}} 4-man ultimate against [[Leviatan]] during the [[LTA South 2025 Split 1]] as the '''Top 3 Play'''.<ref>[https://x.com/lolesports/status/18871533127529023511 LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* Fans started nicknaming him "Resenhudo" after he trashtalked [[tinowns]] and [[LOUD]]'s fans after his first win against them in the [[LTA South 2025 Split 1|LTA South]].
* He announced his retirement as a professional player in a stream a few minutes before [[paiN Gaming|paiN]]'s post, claiming that he was tired and had no motivation to continue competing.<ref>[https://x.com/dynquedo1/status/1894807903028064500 dyNquedo's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x CBLOL Player of the Year (CBLOL 2018 Awards)
* 1x CBLOL Best Midlaner (CBLOL 2018 Awards)
* 1x CBLOL Split All-Pro Team (2024 Split 2)
